verdict.rationale: HumanLayer is a coding-agent orchestration platform, so a feature that scores a repository's agent readiness and auto-remediates failing criteria is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions agent-readiness criteria, readiness checks, or automated remediation of them. Workspace config, automation sessions and workflows are general building blocks that do not deliver this capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can automatically fix failing agent-readiness criteria in my repository
